ACCEPT RULE: write a TheoryTransportV1 receipt (map+synth) only for promoted pairs whose L3 read keeps the mapping expressible in the atoms own vocabulary (no new mechanism vocabulary required). VALIDATE RULE: validate at most the single strongest accepted receipt. ALLOCATION CAPS (frozen): inspections <= 60 (600), promotions <= 4 (160), maps <= 4 (60), synths <= 4 (120), validates <= 1 (50); hard stop 1000.
